about_the_game:
Step into the shoes of a skilled blacksmith and manage your very own forge in this immersive simulation game. With a dynamic day-night cycle, customers visit your shop throughout the day, requesting weapons and armor such as swords, shields, war hammers, axes, and even anchors. Your craftsmanship and customization options will determine customer satisfaction, making every order a new challenge.

Earn money by crafting and selling high-quality gear, then reinvest your profits to upgrade your shop. Purchase better materials, expand your workspace, and refine your skills to create even more impressive items. As your reputation grows, so will your customer base, attracting more prestigious clients with unique demands.

Success isn’t just about forging great equipment—it’s about running a thriving business. Price your goods wisely, manage your resources, and adapt to market trends to stay ahead. Master the art of blacksmithing and build the ultimate forge!
